scope: Only completed trajectory records from the interrupted fixed matrix. The in-progress trajectory is absent, not censored or completed. This ordered prefix does not represent the full matrix and cannot establish the requested 1,000-run outcome.
pauseReason: Coordinator requested a bounded allocation-only optimization with exact physical-state equivalence before sustained completion. No trajectory count or observation horizon was shortened.
timingLimitation: Per-trajectory exact quantiles remain in each record. Raw cross-trajectory timing samples are held only in the paused process; aggregate quantiles are not reconstructed from per-trajectory quantiles.

runDurationSurvival.method: Kaplan–Meier time to any terminal run outcome; administrative censoring is not an event; independence is unproven.

fourIncidentSelection.status: Descriptive selection by observed incident count, not a controlled four-incident completion experiment.
